maddeler.e: مُقَدِّمَة الْحَيَوَانِ الْمَنَوِيِّ • (muqaddima(t) al-ḥayawāni l-manawiyyi) f
maddeler.t: By surface analysis, مُقَدِّمَة (muqaddima, “front side”) + حَيَوَان مَنَوِيّ (ḥayawān manawiyy, “spermatozoon”), literally “front of the spermatozoon”.
s: By surface analysis, مُقَدِّمَة (muqaddima, “front side”) + حَيَوَان مَنَوِيّ (ḥayawān manawiyy, “spermatozoon”), literally “front of the spermatozoon”
